description: Retrieves a noise-reduced accessibility tree in "Golden Format". Hierarchy is shown by space indentation. Each element is represented as: [id] role "name" (val: v) [checked] [disabled] [#]. The "[id]" is the canonical element id in "frameId:axNodeId:domNodeId" format for subsequent element-targeting actions.

purpose.description: Describe why you need the accessibility tree, e.g., locating interactive elements
